propositions: All mode=structured consumers must route exclusively through the PydanticAIRunner facade single-operation path, eliminating bespoke scheduler loops and manual retry machinery
structured_retry_limit is retained as a cap on output-repair retries; structured_retry_limit=0 must yield single-shot fail-safe with zero output-repair attempts and zero request-budget addend
Output repair is performed via pydantic-ai's in-Agent bounded retry (retries={"output":N}) not a bespoke Python loop; a well-formed first response requires exactly one agent.run_sync call

The shared request budget addend (output_retry_allowance) seeds both the Agent retries dict and the constructed UsageLimits, guaranteeing the output-retry counter cannot be exhausted before the request limit
Existing provider fallback eligibility, tool limits, timeout/transport ownership, provenance, serialized output shapes, and candidate tracing behavior must remain unchanged across all consumers
